text:
Linda: Found a banana on the swivel chair in 3B. Is this a gift or a crime? :banana:
Sam: Gift. Respect the banana. :raised_hands:
Priya: Placement matters. Which chair exactly? pic pls
Linda: posted pic: https://imgur.com/a/officebanana (very tasteful)
Max: 10/10 aesthetic. Nominate for office mascot. :trophy:
ops-bot: FYI — reminder not to leave food on shared seating (ants). Kitchen rules: https://intranet/facilities/kitchen-rules
Harper: But also — big mood. This made my day. Kudos banana-anonymous. :clap:
Julia: Propose: Banana Chair Olympics. Events: slow-spin, peel-toss, respectful-return. :laughing:
Amir: Also a one-liner caption contest? Winner gets the banana + a sticker.
Sam: My entry: "Peel before kneel" :banana:
Priya: I like "Seat of potassium"
Linda: Quick poll — react with :banana: to keep it, :no_entry_sign: to remove it, :question: to undecided/fence-sit
Max: Also shoutout to Facilities for having chairs that survive being banana-adjacent. :thumbsup:
Harper: Real shoutout to Priya for clearing crumbs last week — thanks for keeping the kitchen civil :sparkles:
Amir: If no one claims banana by end of day it becomes office mascot. Fair?
Sam: Deal. I'll put a tiny post-it: "Banana goes here if claimed"
ops-bot: Note logged: "banana-on-chair". If this escalates into a weekly ritual, Facilities will charge us in snacks. :robot_face:
Linda: Officially renaming 3B to "The Banana Stand" until further notice. (No more than 3 days) :banana::seat:
Julia: One-liner update thread incoming. Place your best micro-punchlines below.
